bias.zh: 回调加深 · 跌破 $203，逼近 $195

read.en: Zscaler fell 3.1% on Nov 6 to $197.66, trading between $197.10 and $210.52 and closing near the low. It is below the falling 5-day ($215.0) and 10-day ($233.7) and the rising 30-day ($222.1) averages, and above the rising 100-day ($181.3) and 200-day ($167.0). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, still above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($259.69), and RSI is 38.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月6日下跌 3.1%，收于 $197.66，盘中区间 $197.10–210.52，收于低点附近。股价位于下行的 5 日（$215.0）和 10 日均线（$233.7）以及上行的 30 日均线（$222.1）下方，并位于上行的 100 日（$181.3）和 200 日均线（$167.0）上方。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴上方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$259.69），RSI 为 38。

read.en: The close broke the $203–203.3 support (Nov 5 and Oct 16 lows), now resistance; the stock is down 16.9% over five sessions. Resistance is $203–203.3, then $210.5–215 (Nov 6 high, Oct 21 low, 5-day) and $220.1–222.1 (Nov 3–4 lows, 30-day). Support is $195.1 (Sep 29 and Oct 2 lows), then $187.5–187.7 (September lows) and $181.3 (100-day). A close above $203.3 would target $210–215; below $195.1, $187.5.
